_comment: PORT campaign: bridge 2 of IBM Spyre deeptools — DataflowIR -> SentientIR, the D1-D28 span.
The scope is ONE self-contained translation unit, source/bridge2.cpp, holding the 384 function
bodies to port, extracted verbatim from dcc/src/{Transform/Dataflow,Conversion/*} and each
preceded by a banner giving its entry number and its ORIGINAL dcc/src/<file>:<line>.
There is no MLIR, LLVM or dcc header anywhere in this campaign. source/prelude.inc declares
plain-C++ stand-ins for every name the bodies call, so the unit stands alone. The stand-ins
carry names and shapes only — the behaviour to port lives in the bodies.
_comment_excluded: 106 of the span's 490 definitions are NOT in bridge2.cpp, listed with a reason each in
architecture will never need, NOT what is unfinished:
81  C++ field accessors and data members — a struct field in Rust, not a function
19  MLIR pass machinery — createXPass, populateXConversionPatterns, getDependentDialects, the
pass context, pattern-driver configuration. scratchy's #[forward] runs the whole pipeline
at macro expansion: no pass manager, no pattern driver, no rewriter exists at run time
5  printing, parsing and verification — this crate emits and never reads MLIR back
1  a pass driver whose whole body is pipeline plumbing
Nothing is excluded for being hard or unfinished. 50 loop-sensitive functions remain IN scope.
